items.title: Connected fibres give a bijection between the connected components of source and target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a continuous map with connected fibres induces a bijection between the connected components of its source and those of its target (author lemma at source lines 937-947, label lemma-connected-fibres-quotient-topology-connected-components). The proof (source lines 949-963) reduces to connectedness of the preimage of a component, splits a hypothetical separation along the connected fibres and descends the splitting to the component, where connectedness forces one part to be empty (proof lines 949-962). The splitting and descent are the substance. H3.
